summary: GSK plc filed a Form 6-K reporting PDMR share acquisitions under its Share Reward Plan. Each of five executives—including the CFO and several presidents—acquired 14 ordinary shares (7 partnership plus 7 matching) at £19.3496 per share on August 11, 2026, on the London Stock Exchange. This is a routine disclosure of insider transactions, not a special situation. No strategic event, deal terms, or board action is involved. Nothing to watch; the filing is administrative and lacks special-situations relevance.
